tools.name: get_app_store_reviews
tools.description: Fetch recent public customer reviews for an iOS/macOS app from the Apple App Store (one storefront country). Returns rating, title, text, version, date.

app_id.description: Numeric App Store id, e.g. 618783545 (from the apps.apple.com URL)

tools.name: get_dockerhub_repo
tools.description: Get public metadata for a Docker Hub image repository: description, stars, pull count, last updated.
